testCases.title: Verify Brand Checkboxes Displayed in Sidebar
steps: Navigate to the product filtering section.
Observe the sidebar for brand checkboxes.
expectedResults: Brand checkboxes are displayed correctly in the sidebar.

testCases.title: Verify Product Grid Updates by Selected Brand Checkboxes
steps: Select one or more brand checkboxes in the sidebar.
expectedResults: Product grid updates to show only products from the selected brands.

testCases.title: Verify Product Grid Updates by Selected Categories and Brand Checkboxes
steps: Select one or more category checkboxes in the sidebar.
Select one or more brand checkboxes in the sidebar.
expectedResults: Product grid updates to show only products matching both the selected categories and brands.
